# MCP WebdriverIO

A powerful message-based browser automation framework with advanced testing capabilities. Features include visual regression testing, multi-user testing, and comprehensive Allure reporting. Perfect for microservices and distributed systems.

🔑 Key Features:
- Message-based architecture for language-agnostic automation
- Visual regression testing with baseline management
- Multi-user testing with parallel execution
- Detailed Allure reporting with screenshots
- TypeScript-first approach with comprehensive types

🚀 Latest Release: v1.0.5 - Enhanced test reporting and visual testing capabilities
